name: door-upper-powered
comment: BlockDoor.onNeighborBlockChange's upper-half forward (BlockDoor.java:141-143): an iron door at (6,61,2) (lower meta 0, upper meta 8) and a lever (id 69) at (7,62,2), meta 2 (on the stone pillar at x+1), next to the upper half only. use_item on the lever at t=2 turns it on (BlockLever.blockActivated notifies the neighbours of the lever and of the pillar), at t=5 off. The lower half is two cells from the lever and three from the pillar, so no notification reaches it directly: the upper half, notified with the lever's id (canProvidePower), calls onNeighborBlockChange on the lower half, which reads the power at either half (isBlockIndirectlyGettingPowered of the upper half: the lever's isPoweringTo) and opens, then closes, the door. Setting the lever at t=0 already sends the upper half a power-source notification with the lever off (the door stays shut). Needs BlockLever (redstone task of WP-1.6).
